mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at a clear and comfortable 68 degrees near Verona City Hall under a waning crescent moon.

The city has updated its engineering services page. Records of reports submitted to the City Council are now available online, dating back to June of 2018 for those interested in local infrastructure projects.

It is a busy weekend for the community. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Mac's, or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the Verona Ice Arena is hosting a free Girls Try Hockey event.

Looking at the weekly activity, on July 31st, a Madison woman was arrested for O W I and operating with a prohibited alcohol concentration after an officer noticed her vehicle lacked functional taillights.
Stop by Culver's today to grab their delightful Caramel Pecan flavor. The restaurant opens at 10 AM, so get there early to snag a dish before they sell out.
